reviewSummary: Thirty-five attacks were run against the D-266 draft and all thirty-five were refuted against live bytes rather than accepted on the subject's word. The subject is unmoved at d31b6d4b mode 0444. All thirteen cited digests recompute clean, file 08 and COORD match their blobs at HEAD, and the live register derives independently to every figure the draft recites: required-now 28, 28 of 28 named, 32 of 32 owners, last gate row DR-G32, DR-120 OPEN, DR-103 OPEN, condition 2 at 5 of 32, condition 4 MET. Dual independent Stage A ACCEPT 0/0 exists, both reviews measured at this draft's own HEAD and both naming packaging-leftover-join.v4.json at 03251cc8. The three currency splits the dispatch targets are all carried correctly and tense-scoped: leftover-join.v3 current at draft time and not current only after this successor is recorded, occupancy v9 current with v7 not current, component-manifest leftover-join.v6 current with v3 not current. leftoverDesign is recited as the live pair and the obligation id set is unchanged from v3, so nothing is invented and nothing is dropped. The five DR-103 leftovers are disjoint from this row's obligations and are explicitly not stolen. The no-cell-edit branch enumerates 29 contiguous entries and excludes D-236, which git independently confirms is the last file-08 cell edit. Nothing is SATISFIED, no identifier is occupied, required-now is unchanged, and docs/v2/implementation/ is not authorized. Zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX.
